title: A report line that states a step's or lane's progress cites a live read made that turn
why: Incident 11:41 CST Nov 13 (retrospective): it told the owner step rounds-rules-one-record was "still in progress" from its roadmap status alone. Fact: its lane finished 19:42 CST Nov 12 and PR #2888 sat green in batch 133, unmerged. Owner 11:41 CST: "is anyone tracking how close that step/lane is or you just fluffed pretending that lane is tstill goping".
note: Guard: a report or reply line that says how far a step or lane has got (in progress, nearly done, waiting) must cite a live read made that turn: get_session for a lane, PR state for a PR, the batch PR for a batch. The remedy names the read to make. Checked at Stop on the reply text only. A part of step answered-needs-source is the other home; the lane that builds it decides. False-alarm test: a line that cites its live read, or says "unmeasured", passes. Folded into counts-from-rest (retrospective 11:46 CST Nov 13). Unfolded (coordinator 11:59 CST Nov 13): a separate Stop guard on report text, not a test case of counts-from-rest (lane counts-from-rest: different trigger and remedy; its PR #3172 is past round 3 and goes as is). Ready, its own lane; the coordinator starts it. Coordinator 11:59 CST Nov 13: doing, express, lane session_013NEJKzXpdXD5b3J8wYd4eT.
